dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey! There're some things floating on the water...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hmm, I can't quite make out what they are. Let's bring them in and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I'll take the rudder. Traveler, Xinyan — go reel them in.
